entities.summary: Joseph Jules Beecken was a Belgian middleweight boxer who competed in the 1920s. He won the bronze medal in boxing at the 1924 Summer Olympics in the middleweight category, losing against John Elliott in the semi-final. He won the bronze medal bout against Leslie Black.
